The AHEAD Network Specialist Solutions Engineer (SSE) will be focused on Networking technologies. A core tenet and base requirement for this position is mastery of Cisco Route/Switch and/or Datacenter technologies. Outside of this core tenet, our expectation is to attract, recruit and attain resources who have a desire to focus not only on traditional on-premises Cisco solutions, but also to be looking to career, technology and skill advancement by being actively willing to demonstrate skills and ability to learn new technologies including multiple SDN solutions, network security, load balancing, edge / acceleration, and cloud technologies. Understanding that the impetus and impact of Cloud computing is real and should be incorporated into solutions is key. Experience or eagerness to learn about and with network and system / access design with Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure or other cloud services is a key requirement. The SSE is considered a subject matter expert in these areas with responsibility for selling and designing complex solutions. The SSE is also considered an organizational thought leader for their specialty area.

And with the mission of creating cloud software that helps speed up the innovation and delivery of critical treatments and medicines to patients around the globe, it simply doesn’t get any more important than this. Your impact as a technical problem-solver will mean you will be focused on building software that can not only scale for heavy use, but that can also evolve with new features and capabilities. You will have equal influence to drive the direction of the build, be an advisor to product leadership and mentor freshly minted software engineers in their new careers. We are looking for engineers that would thrive in a dynamic, startup environment while having the stability of a successful, profitable company. You have extensive experience in full-stack software development in Java and/or React. You’ve ideally worked in enterprise software development or for a high-growth technology company.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant - English & Korean Speaking
jobs.location_raw: South Korea - Seoul · China - Dalian · China - Beijing
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva Systems is looking for Senior Technical Consultants, who have strong technical and consulting background, and a passion for helping customers achieve their business vision, are wishing to participate in the transformation of the Life Sciences Industry and in addition are interested in learning all the details about Cloud System Management. Technical Consultants will work with regional and/or global service teams closely to build technical solutions including system integration to help deliver successful implementations. The Technical Consultants are members of our Professional Services (Consulting) Organization, providing Project and Post-Go-Live application consulting as a subject matter expert of Veeva Commercial and R&D Cloud products portfolio.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant - R&D Cloud Solutions
jobs.description_text: The Role Shift your career from external consulting to vendor-side ownership. Go-live is only the baseline. Working directly for the software vendor means you own the long-term technical strategy and drive continuous platform evolution with direct access to the R&D engineers who write the code. In this strategic, advisory-led role, you will act as a Subject Matter Expert for Life Sciences leaders, ranging from emerging biotechs to global Top 20 Pharma. Focusing on either Veeva Clinical Operations or Veeva Regulatory,, you will lead complex platform architecture, drive legacy-to-cloud change management, and directly influence future product roadmaps from within our expanding CEE hub of 60+ consultants across Poland and Hungary supported by Veeva’s global network of 8,000+ professionals.

jobs.title: Services Engagement Manager - China R&D and Quality Services
jobs.description_text: The Role The Services Engagement Manager (SEM) is responsible for setting our R&D and Quality Cloud customers up for success and representing the entire value proposition and effort behind a R&D and Quality Cloud Implementation. This is a critical role in ensuring successful implementation and serves as an integral part of the sales cycle and during project delivery, acting as a solution expert working in close alignment with the Veeva Sales and Services Teams. With a passion for Software Implementation and expertise in Life Sciences R&D and Quality Sales, our ideal candidate will structure the right solution, set the right expectations, and identify the appropriate project charter; including staffing, timeframes, and associated costs. RFx Responses, and delivery of Proposals and Statements of Work (SOW) is a key deliverable from the SEM, along with strategic alignment of the team prior to project start.

jobs.title: Services Engagement Manager - ClinData
jobs.description_text: The Role The Services Engagement Manager (SEM) is responsible for setting our customers up for success and representing the entire value proposition and effort behind a Veeva ClinData Implementation. This is a critical role in ensuring successful customer engagements during the scoping and planning phase to establish the right strategy for implementation success. The SEM is an integral part of the sales cycle, acting as a solution expert working in close alignment with the Veeva Sales, Strategy, and Services Teams. Utilizing their own clinical trial systems experience and Veeva product knowledge, they will structure the right solution, set the right expectations, and identify the appropriate project charter, including staffing, timeframes, and associated costs. Delivery of Proposals and Statements of Work (SOW) is a key deliverable from the SEM, along with potential implementation partner recommendations and strategic alignment of the team prior to project start.

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test
jobs.description_text: The Role We're hiring experienced Software Engineers in Test to work on Site Vault, a rapidly growing SaaS platform product in the Life Sciences industry encompassing the fields of pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical devices. As part of our Quality Assurance and Release Engineering team, you'll be responsible for functional and automation testing to deliver a top-quality SaaS product. This is a hands-on position playing a vital role in ensuring customer success with each new release. If you are an experienced Quality Engineering professional ready to make an impact and take your career to the next level, we want to hear from you. In our fast-paced environment, you'll be involved in the product development process, taking pride in building great software. You'll collaborate with like-minded engineers in a high-energy setting and leverage your existing skills to learn and grow with us.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant - China Clinical Operations
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva’s Solution Consultants are an integral part of our sales team, partnering with Market Strategies and Account Partners as product experts in the sales cycle. As a Solution Consultant for Clinical Operations, you will provide product and process expertise in the form of consultative discussions, demonstrations, tailored presentations, and conference room pilots with Veeva’s customers and prospects in China. This involves working to understand the clinical trial management and operational challenges of each customer, tailoring events to show how our Veeva Vault Clinical Suite (eTMF, CTMS, Study Training, Payment, Site Connect etc) meets those needs, articulating complex technical and regulatory concepts clearly, and effectively addressing customer questions and concerns.

jobs.title: Strategy Associate - Veeva Link
jobs.location_raw: United Kingdom - London · New York - New York City
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva Link is transforming how the global life sciences industry connects with Key Opinion Leaders in Healthcare. Our applications span every stage of market maturity, from established industry standards to fast-growing emerging solutions, so there is always something new to learn and real room to grow. Our Strategy team owns the market success of our products, from shaping product direction to making sure customers realise lasting value. We are now expanding the Strategy team with a new client value function, and we are looking for a highly motivated Strategy Associate to join the team. Working side by side with our Strategy Directors, you will take direct ownership of client engagement across some of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies. You will build trusted relationships with key stakeholders, equip client teams to get the most from our products, and drive day-to-day product adoption. Along the way, you will analyze user engagement trends, turn end-user insights into input for our product roadmap, and show clients how our products deliver measurable business impact.

jobs.title: Technical Consultant - RTSM
jobs.description_text: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead. At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors. Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities. The Role Veeva Systems, a leader in cloud-based solutions for the global life sciences industry, is looking for a Technical Consultant to join our RTSM (Randomization and Trial Supply Management) team. The Technical Consultant will write custom code for RTSM projects, helping customers expedite trials and bring treatments to patients faster.

jobs.description_text: The Role Level up your career with Veeva RTSM! Join our scaling team as a Technical Operations Support Engineer and help power our world-class IRT/RTSM platform. In this fast-paced hybrid role, you’ll sit at the intersection of Systems Administration, DevOps, and Tier 3 Technical Support, driving AWS migrations, optimizing operational workflows, and solving complex architecture challenges. If you're an ambitious engineer ready for startup style energy backed by a stable, growing public company, this is your opportunity to drive immediate impact and scale your career.

You will operate with speed, focus, and a high level of individual accountability—embodying our core values of Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed.

jobs.title: Validation Analyst - RTSM
jobs.location_raw: South Korea - Busan · South Korea - Seoul
jobs.description_text: The Role We are looking for a Computer Software Validation (CSV) professional with a specialty in clinical trial software. This role would give you the opportunity to work on a leading solution in Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) software. To excel in this role, you will require strong technical writing capabilities and the ability to simplify complex topics. As a member of the RTSM team, you will work closely with Development and Project Management teams to support customer RTSM implementations in a dynamic environment. You will use your expertise to take ownership of the validation process for assigned projects and play an important role in building and maintaining product excellence for the RTSM system.

jobs.title: Vice President of Marketing - Crossix
jobs.location_raw: Pennsylvania - Philadelphia · New York - New York City
jobs.description_text: The Role Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences. Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive DTC and HCP marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes. As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader. We are seeking a Vice President of Marketing to lead marketing for Crossix. In this role, you will shape how our market-leading Measurement and Audience products are positioned across a dynamic and competitive landscape. As a member of the Crossix leadership team, you will partner closely with leaders in Sales, Product, and Strategy, while leading a lean team of product and field marketing professionals.

jobs.title: Compliance Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Anyscale's security and compliance needs are growing as we work with larger and more demanding customers. Compliance is increasingly a customer-facing, contractual function rather than an internal exercise, and we are looking for someone to own it. This role owns that function end to end: our audits, our evidence base, our risk register, and the security diligence that customers put us through before and during a contract. You will work directly with the Head of Security and across engineering, IT, legal, and sales. This is a program-ownership role with the autonomy and accountability that implies. You will not have a senior compliance function above you to defer to; you are that function. In your first year, success looks like a complete and defensible evidence base with clean audit outcomes, a repeatable way to answer customer security diligence, and a risk register that leadership actually uses. jobs.title: Senior Detection and Response Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Anyscale's need to detect and respond to security events across its production and corporate environments is growing as the company scales. We're looking for a Senior Detection and Response Engineer to own detection engineering and to lead incident response when it counts, coordinating the response and driving it to resolution. This is a high-ownership role with real room to shape how detection and response works at Anyscale. You will own the detection pipeline, the response runbooks, and incident response, reporting to the Head of Security and partnering with engineering. This role is based in India. In your first year, success looks like strong detection coverage across our cloud, endpoint, and runtime telemetry, a working correlation and alerting pipeline, and incident response runbooks that have been exercised in practice. jobs.title: Senior Product Security Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Anyscale's product security needs are growing as we ship to larger and more demanding customers. We're looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer to own our secure software development lifecycle and to be engineering's partner on building security into the product. Reporting to the Head of Security, you will work in close partnership with engineering. This is a senior, high-ownership role. You will own and operate a scalable SSDL, partner with engineering on security features and secure design, review the security of existing systems and new initiatives, and own how we find, track, drive to resolution and report on vulnerabilities in what we ship. This role is based in India. In your first year, success looks like an SSDL that scales with engineering rather than gating it, security review embedded in how new initiatives ship, and accurate, on-demand vulnerability reporting backed by a working path to resolution. jobs.title: Analyste en Planification des Actifs
jobs.description_text: Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir. Lyft Urban Solutions fournit les systèmes de vélos et de trottinettes en libre-service qui permettent à des millions de personnes de se déplacer dans plus de 60 villes à travers le monde. jobs.title: AI-First Engineering Intern

Proof-of-concept builds on our own APIs – showing our product and engineering teams what's possible when you build with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought. You'll work closely with senior engineers who are actively rebuilding how we write software, and you'll be part of a global cohort of interns building in parallel across our regions. That combination is the point: senior engineers give you a bar for what production-grade, customer-facing code looks like, and your fellow interns give you a peer group to trade ideas, code, and AI workflows every week.

jobs.description_text: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist. What you will do This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day. Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better. Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. Lead what comes next : With the CE

If you’re ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you. Mollie's position here is rare: we're a payment service provider with a large, established customer base that is now building a full banking proposition on top of it. That means you get the ambition and pace of building something new, combined with the resources, customers, and best practices of a scaled business. jobs.title: (Senior) Insurance Broker Partner Manager (m/f/x)
jobs.description_text: Your role at Eye Security You will recruit, onboard, and manage relationships with new and existing insurance broker partners in order to sell our Cyber Insurance solution in collaboration with insurance brokers. You will serve as the primary point of contact for broker accounts, ensuring satisfaction and alignment with company goals. You will provide the basis for successful collaboration and ongoing development of our business relationships with our partners. From drafting contracts to closing deals, you provide professional support to our partners. You will develop and deliver presentations, webinars, and resources to enhance broker effectiveness. You will present our solutions at trade fairs and events. You will develop close and cooperative partnership s with your colleagues from Sales and Marketing. What you will need You are experienced in distribution, marketplace, insurance broker or reseller partnerships. You have analytical skills and a solid strategic planning ability. You have an entrepreneurial, hands-on mindset and are a team player, striving to find solutions. You are fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written). You have strong relationship-building, presentation, communication, and negotiation skills. You are used to working with ambitious targets. You have or would like to gain understanding of cybersecurity landscape and are able to integrate it into partner / client / service models. You are willing to travel up to 60% of the time. jobs.title: Stagiair(e) Marketing - Growth e/o Content
jobs.description_text: Volg jij een opleiding in marketing, AI, communicatie, (creative) business of een vergelijkbare studie? Zoek je een afstudeerstage en heb je interesse in een focus op content of growth marketing? We hebben jouw creativiteit en vernieuwende ideeën nodig! Wij zijn namelijk op zoek naar een creatieve student die ons helpt met het maken van marketingcampagnes in woord én beeld. Dit betekent een focus op content creatie en/of growth marketing. Wat ga je doen? Dat bepaal je voornamelijk zelf! Afhankelijk van je opleiding en interesses stellen we een takenpakket samen dat aansluit bij de uitdagingen, doelstellingen en projecten die spelen binnen ons team. Is AI je beste vriend? Mooi, daar kunnen we nog veel in ontwikkelingen. Interesse in de Socials? Fijn, we kunnen je creativiteit goed gebruiken. Vlotte pen? Ook prima! Jouw teksten krijgen bij ons het podium dat ze verdienen. Kortom, afhankelijk van jouw input, ideeën en talenten kijken we samen wat je gaat doen, zoals: Vormgeving; Webinarproducties; Website-optimalisatie en -onderhoud; E-mail marketing; Social media; Deep dive in de analytics; Meedenken in plannen rondom AI. Vanaf dag één nemen we je bij de hand en laten je zien hoe de praktijk werkt. Maar na verloop van tijd kun jij het (bijna) helemaal zelf en vertel je ons hoe het beter kan. Met wie werk je samen? Natuurlijk sta je er niet alleen voor. Wij zijn onlangs gegroeid tot een team van zeven enthousiaste marketeers met ieder een eigen specialisme. Genoeg mogelijkheden

jobs.title: Succesvol ingevuld: Senior growth marketeer @ Snelstart
jobs.description_text: Vacature: Senior Growth Marketeer (B2B SaaS) @ Snelstart Impact maken, versnellen en professionaliseren Mandaat en vrijheid Locatie: Amersfoort Uren: 32–40 uur Opleidingsniveau: Hbo Salaris: €4.800 – €7.000 o.b.v. 40 uur Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart zoekt Sound People een senior growth marketeer die strategie en data naadloos verbindt. Snelstart helpt dagelijks ondernemers, boekhouders en accountants slimmer te werken en groeit hard. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Jij wordt eigenaar van de volledige growth-loop: acquisitie, activatie en engagement, en werkt nauw samen met Marketing, Product, Data en Sales. De rol van senior growth marketeer bij Snelstart Ontwikkel, voer uit en schaal de growth-strategie voor self-serve en sales-led acquisitie. Ontwerp en run high-impact experimenten over de hele funnel (campagnes, onboarding, pricing, funnels, content, AI-automatisering). Analyseer gedrag en data diepgaand; identificeer patronen, kansen en bottlenecks. Bouw repeatable growth loops en automatisering voor schaal. Optimaliseer paid performance kanalen (creatives, audiences, attributie). Co-creëer met Product voor betere activation, onboarding en retention. Zet moderne tooling in: AI-personalisatie, marketing automation, tracking, testing, analytics. Werk met leadership aan prioritering, rapportage en roadmap-invloed.
